answer_raw:
The latest flagship Claude model is **Opus 5.5** (undated), which leads in agentic coding and knowledge work while costing 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads [2]. The latest ChatGPT model is **GPT-6.1 Sol** (2026-09-29), which provides near-Astra intelligence for coding, computer use, and professional work at one-fifth of the standard Astra API prices [1].

## Comparison and Coding Verdict

The choice between these two depends on whether you need a specialized agentic framework or a massive, general-purpose intelligence.

**Claude 5.5 (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku)**
The Claude 5.5 family is built around three pillars: the models themselves, **Claude Code** (the agent harness), and **MCP** (the tool layer) [6]. 
*   **Opus 5.5** (undated) is positioned for high-level agentic coding and knowledge work [2].
*   **Sonnet 5.5** (2026-09-28) is an upgrade over Sonnet 5, running 30%+ faster and costing up to 30% less [2]. It is designed for the full software development lifecycle, from scoping changes to fixing bugs [7].
*   **Haiku 5.5** (2026-10-07) is the fastest, most affordable model, designed for high-volume tasks like subagents and browser use [2][4][5].

**ChatGPT (GPT-6.1 Sol / Astra)**
OpenAI's latest intelligence is centered on the **Astra**-level capabilities found in the GPT-6 family [8].
*   **GPT-6.1 Sol** (2026-09-29) is a specialized version of that intelligence, optimized for coding and professional work at a significantly lower price point than the standard Astra API [1].
*   **Codex** (2026-09-29) serves as the agentic coding product, running in a cloud sandbox and capable of executing tasks in parallel or via the ChatGPT UI/CLI [6].

**The Verdict for Coding**
If you are doing **large-scale refactors or long-horizon agentic coding**, I would use **Claude** [6]. The combination of the Opus/Sonnet models with the Claude Code agent harness and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) makes it specifically suited for managing complex, multi-step coding tasks and large codebases [6].

If you need **high-speed, specialized task execution** (like the "near-Astra" capabilities of **GPT-6.1 Sol**), I would go with **ChatGPT** [1]. The Codex agentic product is built for parallel task execution and seamless GitHub integration, making it a strong choice for rapid, iterative development [6].
